analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Ensure the SYN-RECON-01 fix results in at least 249 controllers and 785 routes in the MagicBox codebase.
requirements_understanding: The objective is to verify the structural integrity of the MagicBox codebase post-fix.
A focus on the decomposition into controllers and routes is necessary.
The verification process must be measurable and traceable.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement automated tests to count controllers and routes.
Ensure observability tools are in place to monitor these metrics.
Define clear error handling for discrepancies in expected counts.
clarifications_requested: What specific tools or frameworks should be used for verification?
Are there any specific error thresholds that should trigger alerts?

executive_summary: This project ensures the SYN-RECON-01 fix results in the expected number of controllers and routes, confirming the structural integrity of the MagicBox codebase.

functional_requirements.title: Automated Controller Count Verification
functional_requirements.description: Implement a system to automatically verify that the number of controllers is at least 249.
acceptance_criteria: The system must scan the codebase and count controllers.
The count must be logged and accessible via a dashboard.
Alerts must be generated if the count falls below 249.

functional_requirements.title: Automated Route Count Verification
functional_requirements.description: Implement a system to automatically verify that the number of routes is at least 785.
acceptance_criteria: The system must scan the codebase and count routes.
The count must be logged and accessible via a dashboard.
Alerts must be generated if the count falls below 785.

functional_requirements.title: Controller and Route Logging
functional_requirements.description: Log the results of controller and route counts for auditing purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Logs must include timestamped entries of each count.
Logs must be stored securely and be retrievable for at least one year.
Logs must be accessible to authorized personnel only.

functional_requirements.title: Discrepancy Alert System
functional_requirements.description: Implement an alert system for discrepancies in controller and route counts.
acceptance_criteria: Alerts must be sent to the development team if counts fall below thresholds.
Alerts must include details of the discrepancy and potential causes.
Alerts must be logged for future reference.

functional_requirements.title: Dashboard for Monitoring Counts
functional_requirements.description: Provide a dashboard to monitor controller and route counts in real-time.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard must display current counts of controllers and routes.
The dashboard must update in real-time as changes occur.
Access to the dashboard must be restricted to authorized users.

functional_requirements.title: Error Handling for Count Discrepancies
functional_requirements.description: Define error handling procedures for discrepancies in expected counts.
acceptance_criteria: Procedures must include steps for investigating discrepancies.
Procedures must define roles and responsibilities for resolution.
Documentation of error handling procedures must be maintained.

non_functional_requirements.title: System Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the verification system performs efficiently without degrading application performance.
acceptance_criteria: The verification process must not exceed 5 minutes.
System performance must remain within acceptable limits during verification.
Performance metrics must be logged and reviewed monthly.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.
